name: Loudly
tagline: Loudly is an AI music generation platform with a library of over 170,000 AI-generated tracks across 50 genres. Its AI music generator lets creators customise tempo, mood, and instrumentation to produce unique royalty-free music. Brands, advertisers, and social media creators use it for consistent audio branding.
